name: Burg Starhemberg
kurzbeschreibung: The well-preserved **Starhemberg Castle** from the 13th century overlooks the **Imster Land** and houses a museum featuring armor and a torture chamber.
beschreibung: Burg Starhemberg – With its impressive history and architecture, Burg Starhemberg ranks among the region’s most significant cultural landmarks in **Imst**. This well-preserved 13th-century fortress overlooks the **Imster Land** valley and houses a museum featuring armor and a torture chamber. The diverse event program, including concerts, readings, and workshops, makes every visit unforgettable. Especially memorable are the atmospheric evening tours and themed special exhibitions. Nestled in the charming old town of **Tarrenz**, Burg Starhemberg blends seamlessly into the historic urban landscape. Nearby attractions and cozy cafés invite you to linger. Allow plenty of time—the fortress will captivate you with its beauty and variety.
